new_learnings.text: Buy gate discipline prevented forced entries on a day when 0/3 major indices are green despite decent 2.47:1 breadth. The index-level signal correctly flagged the rotation risk. Supporting evidence: 科创50 -3.24%, semiconductor/component/comms equipment sectors all in bottom 5.
new_learnings.mechanism: Breadth can be misleadingly positive when small-cap retail stocks rise while institutional money rotates out of large-cap growth leaders. Index-level confirmation catches this divergence.

new_learnings.text: MA-distance Rule 2b is the single most effective filter today — it eliminated 芯碁微装 (dist_ma20 +38.6%), 联瑞新材 (+62.7%), and 6+ other candidates that would otherwise look attractive on RPS alone. These are the stocks most likely to mean-revert violently.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks that have run +20-60% above their 20-day moving average have exhausted short-term buyers. The next marginal trade is overwhelmingly likely to be profit-taking, not new entries.

new_learnings.text: The strategy pool (Cheesefortune intersection) has ~40% concentration in 半导体/电子 sectors. When these sectors rotate out (like today), the pool produces almost zero viable candidates. V3 should expand sector coverage to include media, commodities, and defensive sectors.
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector concentration risk in the sourcing pool creates a structural bias — when the dominant sector falls out of favor, the entire candidate pipeline goes dry simultaneously.

new_learnings.text: Semiconductor sector appearing in bottom 5 with 科创50 -3.24% suggests institutional distribution, not retail panic (f10 only 19). This is a 'quiet rotation' — the kind that doesn't trigger panic signals but causes sustained underperformance. Sell-side rotation, not buy-side panic.
new_learnings.mechanism: Low f10 + high sector drawdown = institutions quietly reallocating, not retail dumping. These rotations tend to persist for weeks, not days.
